rules.text: The filter-existing-files setting defaults to false and is sent as a query parameter on the request.
Sorting by series uses the series title, by quality uses the quality name, and by languages uses the language names joined by commas. Missing values sort as an empty string.
Fetched data is not kept after the modal closes, and it is not refetched when the window regains focus.
Sort key and direction can only be changed through the dedicated sort setter, and setting them through the general option setters throws an error.

shows.text: The list of importable files shown is loaded from the manual import API for the given download ids, series, season number and folder.
The loaded items are sorted on the client by the stored sort key and direction. The default sort key is relative path.
The stored options default to the 'all' filter, import mode 'chooseImportMode', and a default column set.
The sorted items are given to a selection provider that wraps the modal's inner content.

sideEffects.text: Opening the modal sends a GET request to the manual import endpoint with the API key header.

unknowns.reason: HTTP GET to a URL built at runtime

findings.explanation: The default sort key 'relativePath' is in the options store (sortKey: 'relativePath'), so that part holds. But sort direction is passed in as a parameter, and the default direction isn't shown. This is minor; the statement says only 'default sort is by relative path', which is supported.
findings.reason: Reworded to say only the default sort key is relative path, since the default direction is passed in and not shown.
findings.statementText: The loaded items are sorted on the client by the stored sort key and direction, and the default sort is by relative path.
